name: Malva (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and white, charged with a white hermitage on the red and three green mallow leaves on the white.
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 30 April 2007 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 16 May 2007; the flag is rectangular, with the fly equal to 3/2 of the hoist, party per pale, the vertical stripe next to the hoist of half the fly red with a white hermitage, and the rest of equal width white with three green mallow leaves.

features.role: three mallow leaves, two above and one below
